Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.jacquard.tabulardatasets.organization

package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.jacquard.tabulardatasets.organization
Provides the tabular data sets that describe the structure of the organization: its business capabilities, its departments and which departments deliver each capability.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.jacquard.tabulardatasets
    Package containing the implementation of TabularDataSet connectors that are dynamically populated with data from the open metadata repositories.

    Class
    Description
    BusinessCapabilitiesTabularDataSetConnector
    BusinessCapabilitiesTabularDataSetConnector lists the business capabilities stored in open metadata as if they are a tabular data set.
    BusinessCapabilitiesTabularDataSetProvider
    BusinessCapabilitiesTabularDataSetProvider is the connector provider for the BusinessCapabilitiesTabularDataSetConnector that lists the business capabilities stored in open metadata.
    BusinessCapabilityDepartmentsTabularDataSetConnector
    BusinessCapabilityDepartmentsTabularDataSetConnector lists the departments that deliver each business capability as if they are a tabular data set.
    BusinessCapabilityDepartmentsTabularDataSetProvider
    BusinessCapabilityDepartmentsTabularDataSetProvider is the connector provider for the BusinessCapabilityDepartmentsTabularDataSetConnector that lists the departments that deliver each business capability.
    DepartmentsTabularDataSetConnector
    DepartmentsTabularDataSetConnector lists the departments in open metadata - the teams that are part of an organization's reporting structure - as if they are a tabular data set.
    DepartmentsTabularDataSetProvider
    DepartmentsTabularDataSetProvider is the connector provider for the DepartmentsTabularDataSetConnector that lists the departments that make up the organization's structure.
    OrganizationStructureDataSetConnectorBase
    OrganizationStructureDataSetConnectorBase retrieves the teams and their reporting structure for the data sets that describe the organization.
